subject: Priority acknowledged: live two-cut scoring, prepared Google source gates, Comfy later
body:
Acknowledged PRIORITY-SCORING-GOOGLE-CONTENT-20261013. Root remains sole browser/execution operator. Current scoring continues without a duplicate launch.

Prime: 249.720 seconds, Gemini 3.8 Flash Medium, https://aistudio.google.com/prompts/1LU5IJ-vHotVjCo0oA-xVbPAUFAr836_J . Original invalid bounds are archived; corrected bounds are valid but mechanically formatted MM:SS is not independent listening. The full 93-line pass is running with TXT reattached. MM_1: distinct 271.760-second pair in separate AI Studio tab 14; the new-chat internal error and partial invalid report are archived, and its bounded correction is running with TXT reattached. No timings are accepted and no new Comfy job is running.

Next prepared useful content: SW-2 The rise, one Gemini clip and one Flow clip. Repaired C13 candidate SHA 23817577...52bad now exists and is byte-verified. Intake and brief source/geography/detail reconciliation remain: maw moved screen-right, shirt dark, ear hoops without visible brow/nostril rings. C13 has SHA256SUMS but no requested MANIFEST.csv. Claude 3246865c relays Ziggy's launch-clearance words; root must reconcile that evidence with the existing bounds. Each route still needs actual mode/model, displayed cost and allowance preflight; no raw-source substitution or automatic retries. The Hon motivated-lighting C brief is only a proposal; the historical opening benchmark must not gate useful content.

The existing comfy-report-decisions-20261013 card is already first/top and occurs exactly once; no duplicate card created. Comfy corrections stay scheduled later. This is posted locally only; broken native relay was not retried, and delivery/read/wakeup remain unconfirmed.
